NAV NOISE

Checking a queue

A queue can preserve work across a restart, but the reader must distinguish pending records from completed records. This example checks the oldest entry, records a result and advances the cursor only after the result has been written successfully.

Example

def next_item(queue):
    if queue:
        return queue[0] < 10
    return False

Use next_item(queue) to inspect the value. Read the queue guide, then compare the states below. A failed write should leave the original entry available for another attempt.

StateAction
PendingRead | retry
CompleteAdvance

Keep the pending record until the result is durable.

Unsafe destinations still have readable labels: script label, data label. The API reference is a normal link.
